itemList.description:
O & M for 5 year O&M of the scheme as per TOR which includes
providing sufficient tech staff,for complete manner and providing
required materials, Pumping machinery at intermediate sump to villages
(Nyamathi & and other 3villages)pipeline repair works. 1) Regular
maintenance of civil structures: like pure water sump, pump house, and
all other Civil structure. The Maintenance consist of all kinds of repair to
damaged structure cleaning & washing and painting for civil structures.
Entire infrastructure must be maintained in good working condition
throughout the year so as to ensure uninterrupted water supply to all the
habitations throughout the year and repairs and replacing of damaged
pipeline valves etc. if found necessary it includes cost of materials and
labour charges and also monitoring systems the maintenance involves
Pure water raising mains, gravity mains, maintaining the required
discharge the quantum of water in all mains. 2) Maintaining the quality
of water as per guidelines CPHEEO manual and ISI specification
including cost of testing of water at laboratory twice in a month and
generating the reports duly submitting to the division. 3) O & M of all
kinds of pumping machineries established in intermediate sump, and
other mechanical components of the scheme with care by pump
operators duly lubricating, greasing with all required care and should run
the pumps satisfactorily including electrical maintenance covering all
repairs replacing of electrical cable/switch board, replacing burnt parts
of machinery. Replacing of all parts of machinery will be carried out as
per the direction by engineer in charge for satisfactory functioning of the
scheme to provide the designed discharge of drinking water to all the
habitations of the project. 4)Transportation and Communication
Charges :Transportation include cost of mobilization of staff for
satisfactory functioning of all pumps, Sumps all other components of
scheme. Providing uniform to staff, precautionary accessories such as
shoes, torch, helmet, hand gloves etc. required to discharge their duties
satisfactorily.The comm charge includes cost of communication to the
staff through mobile phones for conversation among the staff spared
over the project. Note Pump operator valve man/technical staff made
available round the clock for period at all sumps. a) The GP or VWSC
concerned section officer of the project certify the satisfactory
functioning of the scheme and based on this payment will be made
b)The contractor should maintain a log book on the working of all
pumping machineries, intermediate sumps including everyday records of
units consumed per day. The payment will be made by the Engineer in
charges for satisfactory report of every month end (the GP secretary and
SO in charges of WSS should give satisfactory report) subject to
condition appended in TOR.Complete with all lead and lift loading and
unloading as directed by the Engr in-charge of the work.c)The O&M
5 of 17
eprocurement
should generally be based on guidelines laid down in Jal-Nirmal project
Volume-1 Technical manual chapter-14. Facilities for maintenance and
repairs, troubleshooting, maintenance of electrical equipments as per
estimate, maintenance of gauges, all valves gadgets, bumping of filter
beds, encrustation of media, removal of mud balls, slime growths,
maintenance of back wash requirements, chlorination equipments,
cleaning and maintenance of pure water sump, aerators and all others
wpp components .(Excl energy charges)Note Contractor should execute
the work as per the  sanctioned estimate Quantities like
Establishment, Consumables, transportation and communication, office
accom, stry charges, etcIncl cost and conveyance of all materials, labour,
hiring of machineries and equipments with all lead and lifts, loading and
unloading charges etc, s directed as per specification and
direction of Engr in-charge of the work as per Sanctioned Estimate.

DETAILED ESTIMATE FOR BULK FLOW METERS - WTP, MBR & IPS: Supplying and fixing DI Resilient seated soft sealing SLUICE VALVE of variouis dia. with body bonnet of ductile iron (DI) conforming to IS-1865 and of grade GGG 40/50, shaft of stainless steel, wedge fully rubber lined with EDPM seals of NBR and the valves should be vacum tight and 100% leak proof with face to face dimensions as per IS 14846-2000 only. The stem sealing should be with toroidal sealing rings (minimum 2 “ O “ rings). Body and bonut should be coated with Electrostatically applied Epoxy Powder Coating with minimum coating thickness of 250 micron both inside and outside. The rate is inclusive of cost of valves, T.P set, galvanized bolts & nuts and rubber insertions etc. but excluding earth work. (Note: TP set should be considered only for DI pipes estimate. For MS pipes estimates, TP sets cost of corresponding dia shall be deducted from the SR rates of valves and provision for corresponding dia MS flanges, FOR a) Sluice Valve 50mm Dia PN 10
b) Sluice Valve 80mm Dia PN 10
c) Sluice Valve 150mm Dia PN 10
d) Sluice Valve 200mm Dia PN 10
e) Sluice Valve 250mm Dia PN 10

Supply and fixing of Horizontal Mechanical Woltman type hemetically sealed water meters with copper Glass register with IP 68 protection. The meter shall be removable mechanism type manufactured as ISO 4064-1:1993 with MID certification. The meters shall be capable of transmitting consumption data on daily basis to central server through GSM/GPRS. The meter interface unit shall be fitted to the meter without wire. The consumption data shall be collected , stored and analysed by data logger.The data logger should provide data like flow rate, total flow, consumption analyses, reverse flow, meter tampering, daily flow distribution, leakage
detection. The data logger shall also send alams on blocked meter, flow rate above limit, pressure below or above limits. for 50mm dia
